                var stringCount = outRead.ReadUInt32();

                // vpkstuff patch: the string table was sized from this count alone (0x0FFFFFFF in
                // 56 bytes allocated 2 GB). Every string takes at least its terminator.
                if (stringCount > outBufferLength)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException($"KV3 block declares {stringCount} strings in {outBufferLength} bytes; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
                }

                context.Strings = new string[stringCount];
